items.title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Stock May Command A Premium On Earnings And Cash Flow
items.summary: Texas Instruments has delivered a strong share price run over the past few years, yet the valuation signals are not fully aligned. The intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view points to a price that is close to fair, while market multiples suggest the stock trades at a premium.
